problem.description: Major water supply failure leaving 180,000 residents without tap water for up to 10 days

solution.title: Emergency water distribution and phased pipe replacement
solution.description: Deploy tankers immediately for emergency relief while conducting a survey and executing a phased pipe replacement programme. Installing IoT sensors prevents future failures by enabling proactive leak detection.
steps: Deploy 25 water tankers to serve priority locations (hospitals, schools, elderly care) within 24 hours — city water authority.
Establish 10 community water collection points with daily 200-litre-per-household allocation within 48 hours.
Complete pipe condition survey of the 15 km affected network within 2 weeks — certified contractor.
Award pipe replacement contract (PVC, corrosion-resistant) targeting 6-month completion — public tender.
Install pressure and flow sensors at 20 network junctions for real-time leak monitoring.
Train a 24/7 rapid-response team (8 staff, 4 vehicles) with 2-hour SLA for burst-pipe incidents.
solution.expected_impact: Restore full water supply to 180,000 residents within 10 days (tankers); eliminate recurring outages within 18 months; reduce burst incidents by ~80%.
solution.short_term_action: Deploy tankers and open community collection points within 24 hours.

generator_notes: Short-term (tankers) + long-term (pipe replacement + IoT) both present. Difficulty is medium not hard because pipe replacement is proven technology and funding pathway (municipal + central grant) is standard.

problem.description: Foodborne illness outbreak from central market contamination affecting 20,000 daily visitors

solution.title: Contain outbreak, enforce vendor health standards, and establish permanent food safety regime
solution.description: Immediate containment through market closure and case treatment, followed by vendor re-certification and a permanent rapid-testing laboratory to prevent recurrence.
steps: Close the affected market section for 72 hours and deploy public health officers to identify and isolate contaminated stalls — health authority.
Set up free testing and treatment centres at 3 locations near the market within 24 hours.
Conduct rapid microbiological testing of food samples from all 200+ vendors within 5 days.
Issue re-opening permits only to vendors passing hygiene inspection and completing a 4-hour food-safety training — municipal licensing body.
Establish a permanent rapid-test laboratory at the market funded by a vendor licensing fee surcharge.
Launch a visible hygiene rating display (A/B/C) at each stall, updated quarterly.
solution.expected_impact: Contain current outbreak within 7 days; reduce foodborne illness cases at this market by ~70% within 12 months.
solution.short_term_action: Close affected stalls and open treatment centres within 24 hours.

generator_notes: Difficulty easy because containment and vendor certification are low-cost, proven approaches with clear authority. Permanent lab funded by vendor fee avoids ongoing budget dependency.

problem.description: Chronic signal failures on northern rail causing daily 45–90-minute delays for 65,000 commuters

solution.title: Modernise rail signalling system through phased replacement and interim reliability measures
solution.description: Bridge the funding gap with quick-win maintenance interventions while securing capital for full digital signalling upgrade. A phased rollout avoids full service disruption and allows learning across zones.
steps: Conduct an emergency condition audit of all signal equipment on the 80 km corridor within 4 weeks — rail authority engineering team.
Replace the 20 % of signal units with highest failure rates within 3 months using existing maintenance budget (estimated $400k).
Apply for central government infrastructure grant for full digital signalling upgrade (estimated $8M) — submit within 60 days.
Procure and install European Train Control System (ETCS) Level 1 equipment in 4 phased zones over 24 months.
Run parallel manual back-up protocol during each zone upgrade to cap delays at 15 minutes.
Publish live delay data via open API and commuter app to manage passenger expectations during rollout.
solution.expected_impact: Reduce average daily delays from 45–90 minutes to < 5 minutes within 30 months; improve punctuality from ~60% to ~92% on-time.
solution.short_term_action: Replace top-20% failure-prone signal units within 3 months using existing budget.

generator_notes: Difficulty hard due to multi-year timeline and large capital requirement. However the short-term action (replace worst 20%) is achievable within existing budget and provides immediate relief.
